north_star: Use additional compute only to accelerate evidence collection for a genuinely new long-horizon route-1 algorithm; do not turn the search into route-2 scheduling or a frozen-probe validation exercise.

scientific_protocol.reason: Changing batch size changes unpaired B sampling, PatchNCE negatives, the coupled E/D/G game, and the Adam trajectory. It is a different scientific protocol rather than a harmless throughput optimization.
scientific_protocol.parallelism_unit: independent batch-1 training or causal-audit cell

safety_invariants.numerical_claim: Concurrency changes wall-clock scheduling only. Every accepted row remains bound to its saved full state, source fingerprint, audit lineage, and deterministic row id.

remote4090.policy: Keep four active GPU cells. The formal executor advances from the queue front while two extra workers audit distinct HNEK cells from the far end; dependent e125/e100 workers preserve four-way occupancy after e175/e150. Do not add a fifth stream.

streams: disjoint late-audit chain: HNEK e125 then HJ e150/e175/e200
queued_after_current_work: late-audit follow-up waits for HJ e200 checkpoint without occupying a GPU slot
formal audit executor after all anchors become admissible
remote5090.policy: Use at most three active GPU cells. Precomputed rows remain provisional until the formal executor and final causal-matrix verifier accept their hashes and lineage.

local1660.policy: Keep one stream because 6 GiB memory and lower compute make oversubscription counterproductive.

orchestration_correction.issue: Two 5090 waiting wrappers exposed host-shell interpolation hazards for loop epoch variables; the later wrapper's first explicit HNEK e125 cell was valid but its not-yet-reached HJ loop arguments were empty.
orchestration_correction.impact: The original wrapper was stopped while still sleeping and had written no row. The later wrapper had only started valid HNEK e125; no malformed HJ command had executed.
orchestration_correction.action: Removed the redundant sleeping wrapper and armed an explicit no-loop follow-up for HJ e150, e175, and e200 after valid HNEK e125 completes. The follow-up waits for the e200 checkpoint without consuming GPU capacity.
orchestration_correction.verification: Three active 5090 compute processes were observed at 99% GPU utilization and 5420 MiB total memory. Active cell identities were HJ training, HJ e20 audit, and HNEK e125 audit; the new HNEK stderr remained empty.

capacity_decision.adaptive_rule: Reduce the cap if a scientific process reports CUDA OOM, row-progress stall, non-identical duplicate, parent-state hash mismatch, or sustained throughput regression; never relax an invariant to preserve utilization.

4090_four_stream_benchmark.sampling: ten consecutive nvidia-smi dmon samples after the fourth independent cell initialized
